programme.desc: In this episode of Age Defiantly host Mark Young sits down with neurophysiologist stem cell researcher and founder of StemREGEN Christian Drapeau to explore the profound reality of the bodys innate intelligence Moving past the early politically charged history of embryonic research Drapeau explains that the true future of regenerative medicine lies within our own adult stem cells which serve as the bodys literal everyday repair system The conversation pulls back the curtain on the mainstream trend of exogenous stem cell injections revealing the surprising scientific reality that injected cells are quickly cleared by the lungs and immune system rather than directly repairing tissue Instead Drapeau highlights the power of endogenous stem cell mobilization—using highly targeted safe plant extracts to naturally trigger the bone marrow to release millions of your own CD34 stem cells into arterial circulation By shifting the paradigm of health to a delicate balance between constant cellular erosion and systemic repair Drapeau shares remarkable clinical data regarding the reversal of chronic congestive heart failure and advanced tissue damage offering a safe cumulative method to overcome the steep stem cell declines of aging and unlock long-term vitality

programme.title: The Tenpenny Files - The Rise of the One World Mind- Joshua R Davis
programme.desc: Joshua R Davis is warning that the way people think is being reshaped in real time and most don’t see it happening In his book The Rise of the One World Mind he explains how cultural conditioning globalism and emerging control systems are influencing belief and behavior at scale He connects this shift to biblical prophecy especially the framework described in Revelation where a one world system becomes possible What once required imagination now has a visible pathway The technology exists The coordination is underway The conditioning is already happening Even those who consider themselves aware are not immune and many will be influenced without recognizing it has already taken hold The deeper issue is not external systems alone It is internal readiness This conversation answers a question most people avoid asking themselves How would you know if your thinking has already been influenced How would you recognize it while it is happening Joshua explains how conditioning does not feel like control It feels like agreement It feels like clarity It feels like you came to the conclusion on your own You will hear how values are gradually realigned over time You will hear why people defend ideas today that they would have rejected not long ago The process builds slowly and becomes difficult to detect once it is familiar The discussion moves into systems forming around that shift Artificial intelligence biometric tracking and digital financial structures are expanding across daily life These systems create the ability to monitor behavior and restrict access in ways that were not possible before The concern is not only what these systems can do but how easily people adapt once they are introduced Joshua connects these developments directly to biblical prophecy and the structure described in Revelation A one world system is no longer abstract Technology is removing the barriers that once made global coordination difficult to imagine This interview brings you into the conversation It raises the questions and exposes patterns that are already forming The book The Rise of the One World Mind is where that conversation becomes something you can examine It holds the structure the connections and the research behind what is discussed here What you hear in this interview is the dialogue most people never have What you find in the book is the framework that allows you to understand it in full And once you work through both the question changes from what is happening to whether you would recognize it in time
